content:
Experience your BIM projects in virtual reality!

HIVE is an immersive plugin for viewing 3D BIM models, designed exclusively for professional companies. Showcase architectural and engineering projects in a more realistic, engaging and collaborative way using virtual reality headsets.

Just €9.90 a year!

Special promotional launch price!

Companies

Exclusively for businesses

HIVE has been developed for architecture and engineering firms, as well as designers, who wish to enhance the way they present their 3D models. The solution enables BIM models to be viewed in an immersive environment, facilitating communication with clients, project teams and other stakeholders.

With a simple and straightforward approach, HIVE helps transform technical presentations into clearer and more interactive visual experiences. The current version enhances this experience with improved graphics and a range of collaborative features.

Features

HIVE offers a seamless, realistic and practical virtual reality experience for professional use. The focus is on project presentations, visual analysis and collaboration between teams and clients.

Multi-user collaboration

Several users can be on the same model at the same time, making HIVE particularly useful for project presentations, coordination meetings and client sign-offs.

Greater graphic fidelity

Enhanced visual quality to heighten the sense of immersion and make the experience of exploring the model more realistic.

Night-time view and lighting

HIVE allows you to add lighting and adjust the environment to view the model at night, helping you to analyse the project’s visual behaviour in various contexts.

Model manipulation

Users can highlight elements, adjust the opacity, rotate the model, change its position and adjust the scale to suit different analysis and presentation needs.

Day-night cycle and solar analysis

Other notable features include day/night cycle control and solar analysis tools for spatial and environmental analysis of the model.

Weather monitoring

Possible to change weather conditions, including rain, clouds and fog, to simulate different scenarios and enhance the project’s visual appeal.

Detailed information on the elements

The app allows you to view general project information and specific details for each element, including lists sorted by ID and by category.

How it works

Three steps to enter the project:

Import the BIM model

Upload the 3D model and prepare it for viewing in a virtual environment.

Step into the immersive environment

Use the virtual reality headset to explore the project with greater realism and spatial awareness.

Present, analyse and collaborate

Share the experience with customers and teams to speed up understanding, gather feedback and support decision-making.

Simple, accessible and ready to use!

For just €9.90 per year, HIVE offers a highly competitive solution for firms looking to incorporate virtual reality into the presentation and analysis of their projects.
